title: Mediterranean Salmon and Hummus Breakfast Wraps
intro: This fast, no-cook breakfast is ready to eat as quickly as you can mix and assemble the ingredients. Flaky canned salmon and creamy hummus replace traditional breakfast meats to create a morning wrap that prevents mid-morning hunger.

ingredients.name: Canned pink salmon (no-salt-added), rinsed and drained
ingredients.canonical_name: Fish, salmon, pink, canned, drained solids, without added salt

instructions: Flake the salmon with a fork in a medium bowl.
Stir the hummus, lemon juice, dill, and black pepper into the salmon until combined.
Lay the whole-wheat tortillas flat on a clean workspace and distribute the baby spinach evenly over each.
Spoon the salmon and hummus mixture evenly over the spinach.
Top with the diced cucumber and sliced red onion.
Roll the tortillas tightly to form firm wraps.
Serve the wraps immediately with the fresh berries on the side.
variation: Swap the baby spinach for fresh arugula or baby kale.
conservation: Best enjoyed right away; does not keep well once assembled.

[cooking_method_suitability] The volume of filling is a physical impossibility for the specified tortilla size. Each serving calls for half the mix: 1 cup spinach, 1/2 cup cucumber, over 1/8 cup onion, and about 3/4 cup of the salmon/hummus mixture. That is roughly 2.5 cups of filling per person. You cannot tightly roll 2.5 cups of filling into a single 6-inch fajita tortilla without it completely bursting. Fix: Change to 8-inch (soft taco) tortillas (which will keep carbs within the 55g ceiling), or serve as two 6-inch open-faced tostadas/flatbreads per person.
